observations: Predicted 20 units at ordering to consume four daily for three days and retain eight.
Tests gave with-buffer 20 versus no-buffer 12; maximum ten days gave 48 versus 40.
Screenshot showed aggregate stock bars. Reveal preserved original/current context, distinguished stock at reorder from purchase quantity, and limited constant-demand rule.

caveat: Constant demand and delay; no actual stock policy or stochastic safety-stock calculation.
